visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man wearing a blue and white patterned camouflage-style jacket, black pants, and a helmet is standing on a snowboard in a wide, flat snowy area. He begins to glide slowly across the white surface. The background consists of a dense forest of dark evergreen and bare deciduous trees under a heavily overcast, misty grey sky. (2) The camera follows him as he gains slight momentum, moving towards the right side of the frame. In the mid-ground, other individuals are visible either standing or sitting on the snow. A ski lift structure with chairs and cables is visible against the hillside. A small wooden utility building sits near the edge of the snowy path. (3) The snowboarder attempts a small jump or rotation but loses his balance mid-air. He falls backward, landing flat on his back on the snow. He remains lying down for several seconds. In the foreground, a woman and a small child in beige and grey winter gear walk past the fallen snowboarder, seemingly unconcerned, as the camera continues to record the still figure on the ground.
